reason_codes.meaning: Complete ordinary evidence supports presently operative text for later record construction.
Validly made material is not proved operative and remains outside current search.
The artifact's present effect is completely represented by another tracked authority.
Accepted evidence proves the location ended, expired, or was superseded.
An unresolved, conflicting, or incompletely covered material fact prevents search.
An upstream checkpoint has not passed and no legal disposition is assigned here.
A publication or status signal alone cannot establish one legal disposition.
